headline: Every event in Sri Lanka, in ONE place
subhead: Everything an event needs already exists: performers, caterers, crews and audiences. It is just scattered across chats, contacts and platforms. Tezera brings the pieces into one place. Organisers hire verified vendors and freelancers, fill stalls and share the venue map. Attendees find what is on, who is going and where everything is.
detail: Every finished job leaves a review the next organiser can read, so vendors and freelancers win work on their track record, not their contacts. Accounts are checked by our team before hiring or stalls open.
